content: A SIDI, idar Dawud, idar marra aweddeb nnes,
mammec ijjuǧ i SIDI, iwaɛd i Umzemmar n Yaɛqub:
“Uct, mařa ad adfeɣ ɣar taqidunt n taddart inu, ad ḥebceɣ x qama n řectu inu,
ad semmḥeɣ yiḍeṣ i tiṭṭawin inu, uřa d anudem i wabřiwen inu,
qbeř i ɣa afeɣ amcan i SIDI, ict n Tzeddiɣt i SIDI, Amzemmar n Yaɛqub!”
Xzar, nesřa x Ttabut di Ifrata, nufa i-tt deg iyyaren n Yaɛar.
Ad nadef ɣar tzeddiɣin nnes, ad nesjed i tnebdat n iḍaren nnes.
Kkar, SIDI, uyur ɣar arraḥet nnec, Cek d Ttabut n jjehd nnec.
Ejj ikehhanen nnec ad yarḍen s tsegda, imtiqqan nnec ad sřiweřwen.
War dd-tarri udem n umedhun nnec di ṭṭweɛ n umsexxar nnec Dawud.
SIDI ijjuǧ i Dawud s řaman, ɛemmarṣ ad iḥeyyed Netta x tjaǧit nnes: “Zi řɣiǧet n uɛeddis nnec ad ssɣimeɣ ijj x řɛarc nnec.
Mařa iḥenjiren nnec ad ḥḍan Řɛahd inu d cchadat inu, tinni d asen i ɣa ssřemdeɣ, xenni uřa d iḥenjiren nsen ad qqimen x řkursi nnec i řebda.”
Maɣar SIDI ifarz Ṣihyun, imeẓri tt d tazeddiɣt i Yixef nnes.
“Wa d amcan n arrahet inu i řebda, da i xseɣ ad zedɣeɣ, Necc xseɣ t.
Ad barkeɣ nniɛmet n Ṣihyun, ad ssjiwneɣ imezřaḍ nnes s weɣrum.
Ad ssyarḍeɣ ikehhanen nnes s usenjem, imtiqqan nnes ad sřiweřwen s jjehd.
Dinni ad ssɣemmyeɣ ijj n uyicc i Dawud, ijj n řefnar i umedhun inu sswejdeɣ t din.
Ad ssyarḍeɣ řɛedyan nnes s useḍḥi, maca ad xas innuwar ttaj n weɛzař nnes.”

footnotes.text: Yaɛar- ixs ad yini ‘Qaryat-Yaɛarim’ mani iǧan Ttabut awarni dd-idweř zi temmurt n Ifilisṭiniyyen (1 Ṣm. 6:21-7:2; 1 Im. 13:6).
